details:
Hi, i was on vrchat for nearly half of year and its really good platform, but there is still very big issues that can ruin the experience.

And sorry for my maybe bad English, because i`m not a native speaker. 

So the biggest concern and #1 on this list is Performance:

1. Most of users on PC use Very Poor avatars, you can not really get from it, because some avatar bases like Nardoragon v2 was used to be on the Medium margins and if you add any clothes you will easily turn any avatar to Very Poor (Nardo V3 is more optimized, but still problem exist). The problem there is not an end users, but creators what does not really care about performance aspects regarding their paid assets. Yes, i saw and own bunch of paid assets that are used to kill the perfo because of authors add absurd amount of mesh particles or other stuff just to make their stuff to look fancy and you can not really get rid of it without tinkering with asset.

2. Very Poor are not really represent real avatar performance. Yes, as is said earlier most of PCVR-PC users are using Very Poor avatars. But, there is an catch, because you can have Very Poor ranked avatar, but it can be optimized and have active amount of polygons in Medium margins, because most of your objects are not active all the time (because they are clothes or etc). In other hand, you can have Very Poor avatar that can have absurd amount of active polygons and you just can crush or lag other ppl easily.

3. The more strict limits are required! I think the best way to get rid of "kids-crashers" is add max cap of things that can have VRchat avatar even on Very Poor rank. I think the best way to add max cap of 500000 triangles for mesh and 250000 for particles (that's enough for fancy avatars and will not super-lag modern GPUs) and maybe vrchat team need to flag and verify any avatar that have absurd amount of triangles right now. The next, is VRAM. VRAM cap need to be strict and i think that 150MB texture memory cap for any avatar is enough and needs to be forced (like the max download size). 

The reason is: fast GPU`s became much more affordable, but still any GPU that have more than 8 GB VRAM still are expensive and the most of ppl and creators are still just do not care to compress the textures to make their avatars (or assets) more optimized (yes i have 3090 with 24 gb vram and i can load all the avatars in world without big concern regarding texture usage, but my own avatars that are complex, still in 150 MB texture memory cap). 

The concern #2 is custom clients and crashers. 

I do not really care if someone use custom client just for fun and without any destructive actions like crashing ppl. But, there is a lot of custom clients that just let kids to do the crashing and to become a god`s of public instances, so vrchat team need to refine the security aspect of vrchat. 

And yes, the custom clients let the users ability to crash anyone and its not much related to avatars now because there is now methods that can be used to crash people by using sounds or other stuff. 

 

The concern #3 sounds and stuff. 

Sounds from avatars needs to be fully limited, there is no real need to make the cap more than 256 audio sources per avatar (i guess less is better, because most avatars use less than 50). 2D soundscape needs to be removed entirely from avatars.  

The bounding box size restriction needs to be in place to restrict users to make it ultra-big and fill it with effects to annoy another ppl. 

The concern #4 Visitors.

Visitors... They can be good PPL and can became good part of community and receive normal ranks very fast. BUT. The most part of visitors that i see, just an annoying trolls or kids, that just put insane amount of workload to the group instance admins or etc. 

I guess there is some ways to deal with it:

Radical - put all Visitors into "Visitor sanctuary" until they will get a higher ranks. 

Medium margin - decrease amount of blocks/reports that needed to get the nuisance rank and to restrict them from entering any public instance until further notice. 

Practical - let the group owners ability to restrict visitors (new users) from entering their instances.
title: Some suggestions regarding vrchat (mostly the Avatars)
